resources.string: No chest strap? %1$s can read your overnight HRV, resting heart rate and sleep from your Garmin device, using your own Garmin Personal API key. Workouts are still created on Intervals.icu.
Create your key on Garmin Connect
The key stays on this phone only, encrypted. %1$s uses it to read your own Garmin data for your personal use, never shares it and never includes it in backups.
Connected, but no night with HRV in the last 30 days: wear your Garmin device in bed.
Garmin rejected the key: it may have expired or been deleted. Create a new one and enter it again.
Garmin is limiting requests: try again later.

Readiness uses one source only: HRV from a Garmin device and from a chest strap have different levels. Switching source restarts the calibration (with Garmin, your Garmin history is loaded right away).
Waiting for last night from Garmin Connect: open the Garmin Connect app to sync your device.
Garmin Connect not reachable: retrying in an hour.
Sleep stages from Garmin Connect. Garmin provides only the totals, not how the stages unfold during the night.
Night from Garmin Connect: HRV measured in %1$d of %2$d five-minute windows.
